title: The Cartographer: a read-only flow that tracks Frequency's search rankings and AI answers and proposes page edits the Owner approves
description: First new department in the master plan (P3, 2026-11-11), gated by Daniel: work starts only when he says go. The Cartographer (SEO and GEO manager in the agent roster) is a new shipped flow, flows/cartographer: off, L1, a dollar cap, and read_research as its only action class. It reads Search Console Pages exports dropped in $FW_HOME/flows/cartographer/imports/ and AI answer checks in answers/ (one JSON per question: question, engine, answer_text, checked_at). Pure parseSearchConsole reads the export; pure proposals names a page with at least 100 impressions at position 8 to 20 (striking distance) and any checked question whose answer does not mention Frequency, each with a change and a why. GET /v1/flows/cartographer answers pages (most impressions first), answers with mentions_frequency, proposals and a state (waiting_for_data on a fresh home). Proposals wait for the Owner: the flow never edits a page, publishes or writes to the outbox. Pulling Search Console by API and running the answer checks on a schedule are later rows. Wave 5 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: flows/cartographer ships off, L1, capped, read_research only, in the Frequency marketing project
parseSearchConsole reads the export and proposals picks exactly the striking-distance page and the answer that misses Frequency
GET /v1/flows/cartographer waits for data on a fresh home, then sorts pages, flags mentions, lists 2 proposals and writes nothing to the outbox
